neighbours.label: the word ending '-ium' when it is its own token piece (hel|ium, Lil|ium, plut|onium, geran|ium), regardless of meaning
neighbours.notes: Spelling, not chemistry: made-up 'frobnium' and the flower Lilium fire strongly; elements without -ium (copper, phosphorus, neon) stay near zero. Weaker on -ium words the tokenizer keeps whole (' stadium' 0.16, ' uranium' 0.43, ' museum' 0.14) and some leak from other '-um' endings ('pendulum' 0.32), so near misses keep the stem and change the ending.
